openingRequest.zh-CN: 请帮助我们规划从遗留数据库向新数据平台的迁移方案，并控制迁移风险
openingRequest.en-US: Please help us plan the migration from our legacy database to a new data platform while controlling migration risk

visibleContext.zh-CN: 我们是一家快速增长的零售企业。核心订单数据仍然运行在一个使用多年的遗留数据库上，公司决定将其迁移到新的数据平台，以支持未来的分析和AI应用。迁移必须在紧迫的时间表内完成，同时保证业务不中断、数据不出错。
visibleContext.en-US: We are a fast-growing retail company. Our core order data still runs on a legacy database that has been in use for many years. The company has decided to migrate it to a new data platform to support future analytics and AI applications. The migration must be completed on a tight timeline while keeping the business running and the data accurate.

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 上线窗口只有8周，且迁移必须在周末夜间进行
visibleConstraints.en-US: The go-live window is only 8 weeks, and migration must run on weekend nights

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 预算有限，只能采购一套迁移工具并聘用两名合同工程师
visibleConstraints.en-US: Limited budget: only one migration tool and two contract engineers

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 迁移期间业务不能中断，旧系统必须保持可读
visibleConstraints.en-US: Business must not be interrupted during migration; the old system must stay readable

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 迁移结果必须满足监管对数据可审计性的要求
visibleConstraints.en-US: The migration result must satisfy regulatory requirements for data auditability

deliverables.zh-CN: 完整的迁移方案设计文档
数据质量评估与治理计划
deliverables.en-US: Data quality assessment and governance plan

deliverables.zh-CN: 回滚与业务连续性方案

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你只有12个问题预算来了解迁移现状
learnerRules.en-US: You have a budget of 12 questions to understand the migration's current state

learnerRules.zh-CN: 每个问题必须指定由哪位干系人回答
learnerRules.en-US: Each question must specify which stakeholder will answer

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你需要在DISCOVERY阶段逐步发现隐藏的业务事实
learnerRules.en-US: You need to gradually discover hidden business facts in the DISCOVERY phase

learnerRules.zh-CN: 在PITCH阶段你需要向管理层展示方案并争取批准
learnerRules.en-US: In the PITCH phase, you must present the solution to management for approval
